samples.text:
The maps show a community sports complex before and after it was redeveloped. Overall, the complex has more sports facilities after the redevelopment, and the grass area is not there anymore.

Before the redevelopment, there was a leisure centre in the middle and a car park in the south-west, near Park Avenue. There were a football pitch in the north-west, an athletics track in the north-east and an outdoor pool in the north, behind the leisure centre. The south-east was only a grass area.

After the redevelopment, the leisure centre, the car park and the athletics track stay the same. The football pitch has been changed to a 3G artificial pitch, and the outdoor pool became a indoor pool which is a little bigger. The biggest change is in the grass area, it has been replaced by tennis courts, a climbing wall and a café. Also, a running path was build from the car park to the east side, between the new facilities and the leisure centre.
samples.why: Overview present · main changes covered with some supporting detail · simple linking · adequate vocabulary · errors in agreement, articles, tense and a comma splice that do not affect meaning.

samples.text:
The maps illustrate a community sports complex before and after its redevelopment. Overall, the complex has been upgraded and expanded, with the grass area in the south-east completely replaced by new facilities, while the leisure centre, the car park and the athletics track have been kept.

In the northern half of the site, the athletics track in the north-east has remained unchanged. However, the football pitch in the north-west has been replaced by a 3G artificial pitch, and the outdoor pool behind the leisure centre has been replaced by a slightly larger indoor pool.

The most noticeable changes have taken place in the south. The large grass area between the car park and the eastern edge of the site, which used to be empty, has been developed into three separate facilities: tennis courts, a climbing wall and, in the far south-east, a small café. Furthermore, a running path has been added. It starts at the north-eastern corner of the car park and run eastwards to the edge of the complex, passing between these new facilities and the leisure centre.
samples.why: Clear overview · logical organisation by area · range of cohesive devices · appropriate vocabulary (upgraded, developed into) · mostly accurate with a minor agreement error.

samples.text:
The maps compare a community sports complex before and after it was redeveloped. In general, the complex now offers a far wider range of facilities, with the formerly unused grass area put to use and two existing facilities modernised, although its overall layout around the central leisure centre is unchanged.

The leisure centre itself, the car park beside Park Avenue in the south-west and the athletics track in the north-east all remain in their original form. The football pitch in the north-west, however, has been replaced by a 3G artificial pitch of the same size, and the outdoor pool to the north of the leisure centre has been superseded by a slightly larger indoor pool.

The southern half of the complex has undergone the most radical transformation. The open grass area that previously stretched from the car park to the eastern boundary has been entirely built over, with tennis courts nearest the car park, a climbing wall to their east and a small café in the south-eastern corner. These new facilities are separated from the leisure centre by a newly laid running path, which leads eastwards from the corner of the car park to the edge of the site.
samples.why: Clear, well-judged overview · changes skilfully selected and precisely positioned · seamless referencing and cohesion · precise vocabulary (superseded, built over) · wide range of complex structures, error-free.
